question: At which of the following places the written form of teachings of Jainism in which they are presently available, were written around 1500 years ago?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Valabhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Valabhi**, located in present-day **Gujarat, India**, was a significant center for **Jain learning and literature**.
 
• The written form of the teachings of **Jainism** that are available today were compiled during a council held in **Valabhi around 1500 years ago.**</
